changes: Implemented Lattice CLI real-host unattended runner v1.0.1 for Claude Code first: policy opt-in allowRealHostSubprocess, canonical claude --print launcher allowlist, bounded subprocess runner, filtered env, transcript/runner metadata, review/watch/merge evidence, docs, and deterministic smoke coverage.
usage: Create a dispatch policy for claude-code with allowRealHostSubprocess=true and commandAllowlist including claude --print <prompt-file>, then run dispatch_auto --host=claude-code and inspect dispatch_status/watch/review/merge_plan. Merge remains manual-only.
expectedOutcome: A user can safely let Lattice CLI launch Claude Code as an unattended subprocess only under explicit policy, while Gemini/Codex stay scaffolded/refused and all authority fields remain false.
actualTranscript: Builds passed; unattended-dispatch-smoke passed; dispatch-run-smoke passed; validate passed with 15/15 verification intents covered. CLI canary recorded runnerKind=claude-code-real, changedFiles inside allowed scope, missing launcher refusal, manualOnly=true, authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.
outcomeDiff: No functional gap. Provider live call was intentionally replaced by a fake claude binary in PATH to avoid spending user Claude quota while exercising the real dist/cli.js dispatch flow.
limitations: Claude Code is the only real subprocess host in this version; Gemini and Codex remain scaffolded/refused. Local receipt is still not server authority and merge remains manual-only.
pitfalls: Global lattice resolved to the main repo during one preflight and produced a stale Codex adapter hash; use node bin/lattice.js inside story worktrees for gate-critical local evidence.
